reconciliation.summary: The Store-scale retained-runtime pressure is materially narrowed. Release research-bytecode SHA-256 fell from 64.0360 s to 0.41799 s at 16 KiB (153.2x), and 4.2376 s to 0.02818 s at 1 KiB. A profiled 1 KiB request reported 285,542 instructions, 19,552 nested calls, 4.11 ms scalar primitive time, and 81.9 ms profiled execution, showing generic executor administration rather than arithmetic was dominant. The remaining corpus boundary is the existing default 32,768-step harness budget for table cases requiring about 32,786 steps; explicit 65,536 remains required there.

pressures.title: Step-cost and boundary-crossing pressure at store scale
